messages:
maya: heads-up: the v4-alpha-int4+kvmerge candidate we started shadowing yesterday shows a repeatable drop on the long-doc factuality cohort (docs > 3k tokens). small but consistent across seeds.
leo: how small? numbers help us decide if we auto-fallback.
maya: MRR -2.1% vs v3-stable on the long-doc slice, answer-coherence drops ~4.5% (classifier). p95 latency improved ~8%.
sophie: did we change the instruction template or system prompt during compile? those often change distribution.
maya: no prompt change. compiler flags: `--kv-merge --quant-int4 --prefer-fast-kernel`. KPIs attached in the eval report.
eval-bot: generated full diff report: https://s3.redwood/ci/3167890123/diff.html. automated rule check: factuality_delta=+4.53% (above 3%), mrr_delta=-2.14% (above -1.5%). recommended hold.
leo: ops-bot, can you pause promotions and mute automatic rollouts for this variant?
ops-bot: promotion gate paused for model v4-alpha-int4-kvmerge. webhook notifications suppressed. require manual review to resume.
sophie: ok. next steps: reproduce with higher seqlen (4096/8192), and run bisect with `--kv-merge` toggled. also run multiturn followups simulating user clarifications.
rashid: i'll launch the higher-seqlen job now. command: `./eval_runner --model v4-alpha-int4-kvmerge --slices long-doc --seqlen 8192 --runs 12 --out /tmp/316789_rerun.json`
maya: thanks. also capture logits + token alignments for the worst 20 regressions so we can diff beam probs.
eval-bot: rerun queued: job id 316789A. will post results when complete.
sophie: we should tighten the onboard gate thresholds in the rollout doc: propose these auto-fallback rules:
- factuality classifier delta >= 3.0% on any supervised long-doc slice -> immediate fallback
- MRR delta <= -1.5% across primary slices sustained for 20m -> pause + page
- if multiturn coherence drops >= 3% in followup sims -> hold and run beam=5 check
- performance regressions p95 > +20% -> separate perf gate, do not trigger quality fallback automatically
leo: +1. add a note: when compile flags include kv-merge, require an extra long-doc smoke run before any staged traffic.
maya: agreed. once rerun completes i'll upload traces and open an issue linking diffs and candidate artifacts. aiming to have a clear rollback vs fix call within 1h.
rashid: rerun started. will ping when logs/traces ready.
leo: if rerun reproduces, plan: revert compile flag (kv-merge off) and retry quant-only path; if that fixes, we can iterate on kv-merge in a gated branch.
sophie: i'll update the rollout playbook with these new hard thresholds and add a checklist for `kv-merge` variants (extra smoke + token-diff).
maya: thanks team. will post a triage summary with links when the rerun finishes. :hourglass:
